subject.title: fix(gateway): recover when suppressed channel secrets are unavailable

question: Should the canonical fix keep breaker-specific projection policy local to gateway startup as this PR does, or expand the generic secrets fast-path API as proposed by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106405?
rationale: Both branches are proof-positive and appear functionally correct, but selecting the permanent ownership boundary is a code-architecture choice that automation cannot safely resolve.

options.title: Land the gateway-local fix
options.body: Refresh and land this PR because it uses the existing source/assignment snapshot contract without expanding generic secrets-runtime APIs.

options.title: Land the broader runtime fix
options.body: Choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106405 if owners want assignmentConfig to become an explicit generic fast-path API, then close this PR.

recommendation.title: Land the gateway-local fix
recommendation.body: Refresh and land this PR because it uses the existing source/assignment snapshot contract without expanding generic secrets-runtime APIs.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the breaker and are best positioned to confirm its intended startup and recovery boundary.
